scope: Replace the Surfa objects in connectome _registration only; FLIRT optimization, tracking, FOD, SIFT2 and matrix assignment unchanged

input.source: OpenNeuro ds004666 real T1w paired with FSL TOPUP/EDDY-corrected AP DWI mean b0
input.b0_selection: arithmetic mean of corrected DWI volume indices 0, 21, 42, 63, 84; retained DWI affine

environment.timing_boundary: Only _registration or the corresponding FSL flirt command; each arm run once on a shared host

old_new.output: DWI world-RAS to T1 world-RAS 4x4 torch.float32 matrix

official_fsl_vs_new.comparison: Convert FSL scaled-mm matrix to DWI-to-T1 world-RAS, sample 13x13x13 points across DWI voxel grid, calculate Euclidean displacement from FNIT matrix
official_fsl_vs_new.note: This full-head b0/T1 comparison differs from the prior brain-extracted b0/T1 benchmark; old and new FNIT matrices are identical, so the FSL difference predates this migration

not_tested: Full real-data connectome, FOD, tractography, SIFT2 and four region matrices were not rerun
No new GPU paired registration timing
Only one real corrected b0/T1 pair and one execution per arm; no speedup conclusion
